Ahi with Spinach Salad
 
Save Print
Author: Genevieve Hammil
Serves: 4
Ingredients
  • ¼ Cup(s) olive oil
  • 1 Cup(s) finely diced yellow onion
  • 2 Teaspoon(s) minced garlic (or more!)
  • 1 Teaspoon(s) dried oregano
  • 4 Cup(s) fresh spinach (or one bag)
  • 1 Can(s) black beans, drained and rinsed (15 ounces)
  • 1 Tablespoon(s) lime juice
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) kosher salt
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) curry powder
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) pure chile powder
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) freshly ground pepper
  • 4 ahi steaks about 1 inch thick
Instructions
  1. In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the oil. Add the onion and cook until transparent (about 5 minutes), stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and oregano and cook until the garlic begins to brown (about 2 minutes). Immediately add the spinach, black beans, lime juice and ¼ teaspoon of kosher salt. Mix well, cover the skillet with a lid and set aside.
  2. In a small bowl, mix 1¼ teaspoons of kosher salt, curry powder, chile powder, and pepper. Brush each side of fish with olive oil. Season them with the spice mixture.
  3. In another large skillet, add 2 tablespoons olive oil and heat over high heat until oil is hot. Add steaks and grill for 2
  4. minutes on each side.
  5. Serve fish on plate and spoon spinach salad over top. You can also lay a bed of couscous, or rice cooked in chicken broth on the bottom of the plate, then the fish on top finishing with the spinach salad on top of that. Yummy!
